title: [Registry Preview] Use full-page workspace layout

status.label: Manual review completion required
status.detail: Eight actual automated requests are exhausted. The final substantive result published three repeated splitter concerns; all were grounded, answered and resolved. Source shows 1-DIP tracks and explicit 8-DIP splitter dimensions, but this does not establish effective layout or pointer behavior. No author defect is asserted without that evidence. The final result was not zero-comment, so human review completion is required, independently of review effort tier.

next_action: Manual exact-head Registry Preview UI verification: exercise both vertical and horizontal splitters by dragging at center and both edges, at initial and changed adjacent-pane sizes. Confirm reliable pointer capture and pane resizing, including no clipping/overlap. If any drag fails, fix on the existing fork feature branch, validate the exact tree after the build slot is released, and manually review the fix; do not request a ninth Copilot review. If both axes reliably resize, record evidence and disposition the repeated hypothesis as unconfirmed/non-defect, then coordinator may finalize after the required exact-tree validation.
